name: Salesforce
tagline: Enterprise CRM with APIs, sandboxes, CLI, metadata, and automation.
shortDescription: Salesforce provides REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata, Tooling APIs, sandboxes, scratch orgs, and Salesforce CLI.
agentSummary: Agents can automate CRM and metadata workflows, but enterprise permissions and object models require careful setup.
bestFor: Enterprise CRM, metadata deployments, customer records, integrations, and sales operations.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Production org writes, PII, workflows, and metadata deployments need admin review. Verify official docs, pricing, rate limits, permissions, and production side effects before delegating account-changing actions to an agent. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public editions and add-ons; enterprise pricing and API limits can be complex.
authModel: OAuth, connected apps, JWT bearer flow, profiles, permission sets, and org scopes.
accountCreation: Developer orgs are self-serve; enterprise orgs are contracted.
browserSupport: Setup UI is central for permissions, apps, and schema review.

capabilities.detail: Salesforce CLI supports org auth, metadata deploys, data operations, and scratch orgs.
Salesforce has REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata, and Tooling APIs.
Developer docs are broad but require platform expertise.
Public editions and add-ons; enterprise pricing and API limits can be complex.
Developer orgs are self-serve; enterprise orgs are contracted.
Setup UI is central for permissions, apps, and schema review.
Sandboxes and scratch orgs support safer agent testing.
